listing.name: Niko's SWP 1.1.1
listing.summary: Just a bunch of weapons I made that I thought were cool but couldn't find anywhere to put them. Weighted pretty low so its rare you'll see any of them.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of rare, low-weight custom weapons including shielded missiles and shield projectors.

description: Adds a variety of unique weapons such as shielded missiles, weapons that project shields, and a sawn-off sabot. These items are weighted to appear rarely in the game.
